h1: PLUMBERS AND DRAINAGE SERVICES FOR ALL OF LEEDS AND WETHERBY
h2: NO CALL OUT CHARGES AND A SAME DAY SERVICE
h3: SMALL JOB SPECIALISTS THAT CAN TAKE CARE OF THE LARGER JOBS TOO – UNVENTED CYLINDER SPECIALIST
A Reliable Local Plumber in Leeds and Wetherby
A Same Day Plumber with Fixed Hourly Rates
paragraphs: We cover all of Leeds and we only charge from the time of arrival, there is no call out fee. We specialise in the smaller jobs and also offer an emergency plumbing service.
As well as
general plumbing
work, you can call us for
gas boiler repairs
, combi boilers,
unvented hot water systems
and for
blocked drain clearance
As plumbers, we have training and qualifications from the
British Plumbing Employers Council
and the gas engineers we use are members of the
Gas Safe Register
We offer a 24 hour emergency plumber service covering the entire Leeds area as well as general small job plumbing.
If you need a pipe freezing we can help, we have a Rothenberger pipe freezing machine to isolate your supply if you have a faulty stoptap.

For all your plumbing needs  from leaking taps to water tank replacement
Gas Safe engineers working on both residential and commercial gas appliances
We’re qualified to work on all types of unvented hot water heaters and cylinders
We are no longer undertaking full bathroom renovations so that we can offer our customers a better same day service for smaller jobs
Blocked Drains  cleared, high pressure drain jetting and drain camera surveys

Leeds Plumbing Solutions provides professional plumbing and drainage services across Leeds and the surrounding areas, including Wetherby, delivering reliable workmanship backed by experience and high standards, offering a trusted local service that homeowners and landlords can rely on.

We are fully qualified, including G3 unvented hot water certification, water regulations approved, and a registered Watersafe contractor. There’s no call-out charge — you only pay from arrival — and all work is fully insured with clear, detailed invoicing.

We focus on the smaller plumbing jobs across Leeds and Wetherby. Dripping taps, constantly running toilets, minor leaks, faulty stop taps, overflow issues, and general day-to-day plumbing faults are the sort of work we handle every day. As a local plumbing company covering all Leeds areas, we are set up for a fast response and can often be with you within the hour. We carry the right parts and equipment to resolve most small plumbing repairs on the first visit, providing a proper fix carried out with care and attention.

As an experienced emergency plumber in Leeds, we understand that plumbing problems often need urgent attention. Where possible, we offer a same-day plumbing service, helping to minimise water damage and disruption. We take care in every property we enter, wearing protective footwear and cleaning thoroughly once work is complete, leaving your home as we found it.

If it runs through a pipe, we can repair it. From general plumbing and emergency call-outs to blocked drains and unvented hot water heaters. We also offer a pipe freezing service.  Leeds Plumbing Solutions provides dependable plumbing services across Leeds and Wetherby, with a focus on quality workmanship and traditional standards of can rely on
You’ll be pleased to know our hourly rates are fixed, no matter what day or time of day you call, so call us anytime – We only charge from arrival
We offer several ways to pay such as cash, credit or debit card and give itemised invoices
Having a van stocked with all the most commonly used items means we can often give a permanent fix that same day.
You can call us anytime if you are requiring help or simply more information.

Most of the time our local Leeds plumber or drainage operative can arrive  within the hour, if we are unable to send an engineer straight a way we shall be honest and inform you of the next available times.
We understand nobody likes to be kept waiting all day and we always strive to arrive on time

Did you search for plumber near me? or even a Plumer in Leeds? Look no more, we cover all of Leeds City Centre, as far out as Barwick, Garforth, Morley, Pudsey, Wetherby, Boston Spa,Tadcaster, Knaresborough, Horsforth, Harewood and surrounding areas.

Other places we regularly get work from include Chapel Allerton, Meanwood, Roundhay, Harehills, Moortown, Weetwood, Headingley, Seacroft, Woodhouse, Farsley, Rothwell, Sheepscar, Cross Gates, Adel and Cookridge.
We’re fully qualified for all we do. All plumbing work shall be carried our by bpec qualified plumbers and any gas work by Gas Safe Register Engineers.
